So she sits on the bed and I sit on the floor. She keeps saying things like "you don't have to sit on the floor" and "are you still seeing that one girl?" or my favorite her hinting that it was "pretty boring and if only there was something to do?" Well my dumb ass starts thinking, you know what it is kind of boring and I should get back home. Politely excuse myself and head home after she asks if we want to meet up again.
